input.value: Third party slip and fall on icy walkway
Medical bills from injury on policyholder's premises

input.rationale: Bodily injury (broken wrist) to a third party (neighbor's child) arising from a condition of the policyholder's premises (icy walkway).

Pediatric injury (9-year-old) with a confirmed broken wrist; medical bills are anticipated and a minor's injury claim requires prompt adjuster attention and potential investigation of premises maintenance during the ice storm.

input.claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bill coverage. This is a pediatric injury claim requiring prompt investigation of premises maintenance and medical documentation.
